family: degree-at-most-four mean kernel, with the three IR cancellations and unit Box normalization
source: unchanged normalized A*exp[-1/(1-4*r*r)]*exp(4*i*z), r<1/2; zero elsewhere; g=0 at t0=-1; mass m=1
detector: unchanged uniform normalized complex field average on ball radius 1/2 centered (0,0,3/2), windows [3/4,1] and [1,5/4]; divide by A/e
finite_input_map: exact continuum KG history at every Omega5 point with t<=-1; finite-domain diagnostic, explicitly distinct from H1 and PU-H1
finite_domain: Omega5: abs(t)+r<5; active points -1<t<5/4; passive detector queries do not enter counts
mean_operator_domain: full causal past, for the rapidly decaying Gaussian control fields only
selection_disclosure: The degree-four family was derived before exploratory float integration. Theta=21 was then chosen near the L=2 fit; L=4 is an added deterministic development stress test. Neither choice is claimed as preregistered or independent validation.
abort_rule: If the extended two-scale mean screen fails rigorously, reject this candidate for continuation and stop before compact-detector production or full spectral search. Preserve the old physical target and method gates.
